description: This file defines the ComponentNodeVisitor class which implements NodeVisitorInterface to modify Twig parse trees for Drupal components, including adding library attachments, context, validation, and debug comments.

classes.name: ComponentNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements a Twig NodeVisitor to inject component-related nodes, handle component validation, and add debug comments in Drupal templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the visitor with a ComponentPluginManager.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Returns the node unchanged upon entering.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Modifies ModuleNode instances to add library attachments, context, validation, and debug comments; also validates slots.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the component plugin based on the module node's template name if it matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the node visitor (250).

methods.name: validateSlots
methods.description: Performs runtime validation of component slots against expected schema, throwing an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: emojiForString
methods.description: Generates a reproducible emoji based on the input string, used for debug comments.
